sources.title: deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 - Cloudflare AI docs
sources.snippet: We introduce DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 552B backbone parameters and support for contexts of up to one million tokens. The model natively processes images and text, and generates text autoregressively.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 · Models
sources.snippet: Technical Report 👁️ Introduction DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 is a minor update to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, delivering substantial improvements across reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks. Alongside these gains, the model reduces task execution time and output length, enabling users to complete tasks faster and at lower cost and advancing the performance-cost Pareto frontier ...
